dedupe_keys.name: geological survey of queensland borehole database specification

description: This repository holds the Geological Survey of Queensland's specification for a new borehole database that replaces the borehole functions of its MERLIN system and serves as the single system of record for all boreholes in Queensland, whether drilled for minerals, coal, petroleum, gas or water. It defines a relational design with core tables for boreholes, the wellbores drilled within them, aliases, associations, status history and documents, plus key-value storage for extended attributes. It is published by the Geological Survey of Queensland in the Queensland Department of Resources, and it draws on the PPDM and WITSML petroleum standards, GeoSciML for minerals and CoalLog for coal. The specification and JSON example data are free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: it is a design document, not the borehole data themselves, and the repository shows no dates, so its status against the live system is unknown. For simulation it shows how a survey structures borehole records, which helps when building subsurface digital twins or linking borehole data from several agencies into ground models for infrastructure and resource studies. It is related to the Global Drillhole Database record in this catalogue, which harmonises borehole data from other surveys.
